# osapi nats permissions

Print the NATS subjects that each osapi process needs.
`osapi dsl command get --name nats permissions` shows the same.

| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | nats permissions                                      |
| Description | Print the NATS subjects that each osapi process needs |
